label: Roadmap delivered
drivers: Permits, grid connections and the CfD scheme from 2027 arrive on time; undated sites are tendered and built.
assumption_note: ILLUSTRATIVE: 8.8 GW undated is the team's assumption, sized to the gap the dated pipeline leaves to 21 GW.

label: Delayed build-out
drivers: Grid-connection and component lead times push every dated site back a year; few undated sites reach commissioning by 2032.
assumption_note: ILLUSTRATIVE: 1-year delay and 2.0 GW undated are team assumptions.

label: Cost squeeze
drivers: Rising costs and weak demand stall tenders (Nederwiek I-A drew no applications): 2-year delays, Gamma tender fails, no undated build by 2032.
assumption_note: ILLUSTRATIVE: 2-year delay, Gamma failure and 0 GW undated are team assumptions.
